thread:
lee (docs): Opening PR for 'airgapped onprem preflight + KMS notes' — draft at https://git.redwood/infra/docs/pull/495. Need quick reviews on network egress, HSM PKCS#11 perms, and offline bundle steps.
shreya (eng-infra): looking. can we include a minimal preflight script customers can run w/o contacting support?
lee (docs): yes — adding a tiny shell that checks ports, tar checksum, and KMS reachability. snippet below.
```
#!/bin/sh
set -e
# ports: outbound 443 to api.redwood.ai and s3.amazonaws.com
nc -z api.redwood.ai 443 || exit 2
nc -z s3.amazonaws.com 443 || exit 3
sha256sum -c /tmp/bundle.tar.gz.sha256 || exit 4
# simple KMS healthcheck
curl -fsS --connect-timeout 5 https://kms.internal.local/health || exit 5
```
rod (eng-runtime): please note some customers use private S3 endpoints — document presigned URL requirement for bootstrap agent.
anya (security): PKCS#11: important to call out `/var/run/pkcs11.sock` perms. Recommend `chown root:hsm` + `chmod 660` and systemd socket unit. also add a short threat mitigation: do not bind to 0.0.0.0.
lee (docs): added both. included vendor links for SoftHSM and Thales: https://www.opendns.example/softHSM (placeholder) and https://thales.example/pkcs11-paths
shreya (eng-infra): also include systemd service for mirror import (airgap). small example: 
```
[Unit]
Description=Redwood offline bundle import
After=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/rw-import --bundle /opt/offline/bundle.tar.gz --owner redwood:ops

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
```
anya (security): add note that the import process should drop privileges after unpacking and verify tarball ownership. Mention `tar --numeric-owner` for sanity.
lee (docs): done. I also added an FAQ entry about checksum mismatches and file perms (`chmod 644` for the bundle file is common mistake).
rod (eng-runtime): small nit: the CLI example used `redwood key rewrap` — add explicit `--token-slot` flag for HSM targets.
lee (docs): updated snippet to `redwood key rewrap --src old-kms --dst hsm://slot1 --token-slot 1 --tenant acme`.
